responsibility: Implements GCC’s tree-to-RTL expansion pass, turning GIMPLE CFGs and statements into RTL while constructing the initial backend CFG. It owns statement and expression lowering helpers such as `gimple_assign_rhs_to_tree`, manages SSA expansion state and storage assignment, emits RTL for function bodies and edge-inserted code, rebuilds jump labels, removes GIMPLE-only abnormal edge markings, rescans RTL into proper basic blocks with `find_many_sub_basic_blocks`, finalizes EH generation and stack alignment details, and finishes with CFG cleanup and verification before later RTL optimization passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the full tree/GIMPLE-to-RTL expansion pass that lowers statements, builds the initial backend CFG, inserts edge code, rebuilds labels, rescans blocks, and finalizes expansion; unlike gcc/cfgexpand.h, it is the implementation of expansion rather than the small helper interface exposed to other code.
